chunks: And in another hadith: "One hundred cubits."

key_terms.حَدِيثٍ: a hadith or narration cited as a source
key_terms.ذِرَاعٍ: a cubit, a unit of length

ai.seo_question: What distance is mentioned in another narration for walking through the Valley of Muḥassir?
ai.summary: This report cites another hadith specifying the measured distance as one hundred cubits. In the context of the ritual of walking through the Valley of Muḥassir, it serves as a brief jurisprudential detail clarifying the extent of the prescribed action.
